{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {patient_id_duplicates}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq
distribution_sample_seq = df['sample_seq'].value_counts().sort_index()
print('\nDistribution of sample_seq:')
print(distribution_sample_seq)

# Confirm that sample_seq > 1 exists
has_multiple_samples = (df['sample_seq'] > 1).sum()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple samples (sample_seq > 1): {has_multiple_samples}')"}
